-a, the mirror image of the open-loop pole
minus infinity, since the cost on x dominates

questions.prompt: A friend says: 'LQR guarantees stability margins, so I do not need to simulate delay.' Best response?
options: The margins apply only when R is large, and then any delay can be ignored safely
The margins hold for the ideal continuous loop; a 50 ms delay or sampling can remove them
Correct, because LQR margins include any delay as part of the guaranteed phase margin
The margins hold only for two-state systems, so a larger plant needs simulation
questions.explanation: Delay adds phase lag; the textbook margins assume no unmodelled dynamics.
